messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Kiera,

Pangea's international energy-transition talent work aligns closely with my background across resources, sustainability and institutional engagement. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across energy transition, mining and infrastructure where responsible growth depends on strong regulator, government and stakeholder relationships. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
